subject: Vendor onboarding: PO format, cutoff times, and line-item guidance
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Angela Moreno <angela.moreno@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: PO format, cutoff times, and line-item guidance

Hi Angela —

Thanks again for partnering with us on the Acme pilot. We’re kicking off procurement intake so we can scope the PO flow and activation timeline. To make sure Finance and Ops have everything they need, can you confirm the following for Acme? I put the core asks below — a one-line answer for each is perfect.

Required PO fields (please confirm whether each is required on your PO):
- Legal entity / remit name
- Bill-to address and contact (billing contact name & email)
- Vendor tax ID / VAT (if applicable)
- PO number field (yes/no)
- SOW or contract reference field

Line-item structure preferences:
- Do you prefer one consolidated SKU per subscription, or itemized SKUs per feature/metric?
- If usage-based, do you need monthly aggregated lines, or per-interval (daily) lines?
- Any mandatory GL code or cost-center field we must pass through?

PO issuance timeline / cutoffs:
- Standard lead time after vendor intake complete (days)
- Cutoff time for same-day activation PO processing (e.g., 3:00pm PT)

Attachments: I’ve attached our vendor_onboarding_form.pdf and vendor_remit_sheet.xlsx — please return the filled forms if possible. Also include a sample invoice PDF so Finance can validate mapping.

Goal: we want to agree on a minimal PO payload and a realistic issuance SLA so Sales and CS can promise an activation date. If you can reply with confirmations and any sample invoice layout by EOD tomorrow, that would be great.

Thanks —

Soojin Lee
Program Manager, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
---
Attachments (mentioned): vendor_onboarding_form.pdf, vendor_remit_sheet.xlsx

From: Angela Moreno <angela.moreno@acme-corp.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: accounts-payable@acme-corp.com
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO format, cutoff times, and line-item guidance

On Thu, 15 Apr 2027 at 9:12 AM Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Angela —
> 
> Thanks again for partnering with us on the Acme pilot. We’re kicking off procurement intake...

Hi Soojin — thanks for the clear list. Answers below (short) and I attached our filled vendor_form_filled.pdf plus a sample invoice layout (acme_sample_invoice.pdf).

Required PO fields:
- Legal entity / remit name: REQUIRED ("Acme Cloud Services, Inc.")
- Bill-to contact: REQUIRED (we need billing contact name + email)
- Vendor tax ID: REQUIRED for US accounts (we can accept either EIN or VAT where applicable)
- PO number field: OPTIONAL but preferred
- SOW/contract reference: PREFERRED (helps our AR team match)

Line-item structure:
- We prefer itemized SKUs per product/metric. For subscription charges, one SKU per subscription tier works; for usage-based charges we prefer aggregated monthly lines (one line per billing period) rather than daily granularity.
- We can accept an additional free-text column for internal cost-center/GL codes, but it’s not mandatory.

PO issuance timeline / cutoffs:
- Typical processing lead time after intake + completed forms: 5–7 business days for new vendor activation (can be faster for renewals).
- For activation POs tied to signed SOWs, we can expedite to 2–3 business days if we receive the completed vendor form + signed SOW before your requested cutoff.
- Our AP cutoff for same-day scheduling: 4:00pm ET (1:00pm PT). If you need earlier, we can try to triage but not guaranteed.

Payment terms: Net30 is standard for Acme. If Redwood requires different terms for pilot accounts, we can discuss.

Let me know if you want to schedule a 20-min call tomorrow to walk through the sample invoice mapping.

Best,

Angela Moreno
Head of Finance Operations — Vendor Relations
Acme Corp
---
Attachments: vendor_form_filled.pdf, acme_sample_invoice.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: PO format, cutoff times, and line-item guidance

Thanks Angela — helpful. Quick internal notes / proposal (so we have a single source to send to Acme):

Summary of Acme asks we can accept:
- Legal entity, billing contact, tax ID: will include on PO template (required)
- Net30: acceptable
- Preferred itemized SKUs with monthly aggregated usage lines: acceptable

Proposed Redwood PO rules (for Sales/CS to follow):
1) Activation PO (SOW-signed): aim for Redwood issuance within 3 business days of completed vendor intake + SOW receipt. This triggers vendor's expedited 2–3 day path.
2) Standard new vendor activation: allow 5–7 business days.
3) Cutoff for same-day processing from Redwood side: 2:00pm PT to reliably hit Acme's expedited window. If payment terms/approval pending, allow 24–48h slack.
4) Line-item template: include SKU, description, quantity, unit_price, period_start, period_end, GL_code (optional). Attached proposed_lineitem_template.csv for review.

Next steps:
- Soojin: confirm we can commit to 2:00pm PT cutoff for activation POs when Sales flags SOW-signed.
- Vivek: please confirm whether Finance needs any additional fields for internal reporting (cost center mapping).
- Angela: if Acme can accept the proposed template, we’ll send a sample PO for your AR team to validate.

Short call would help speed this; I’m available tomorrow 10–11am PT.

—
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_lineitem_template.csv

Angela / team — thanks for the quick turnaround and for returning the filled form. Confirming final alignment so Sales/CS can promise dates to the customer: 

Agreed PO requirements (final):
- Required on PO: legal entity name, bill-to contact (name + email), vendor tax ID, SOW reference (if applicable).
- Preferred: PO number field and GL/cost-center column (we will include GL_code as optional).
- Line-items: itemized SKUs for product/feature; usage-based charges reported as a single aggregated monthly line per billing period.
- Payment terms: Net30 (accepted).

Agreed timelines:
- Activation PO (SOW+completed intake): Redwood will attempt issuance within 2 business days of completed intake if request submitted before 2:00pm PT. This should allow Acme to hit their 2–3 day expedited activation path.
- Standard new vendor activation: 5–7 business days.

Action items:
- Marissa: send sample PO using the attached proposed_lineitem_template.csv by EOD Monday so Acme AR can validate mapping.
- Angela: confirm acceptance of the template and confirm whether accounts-payable needs any modified field headings.
- Vivek: confirm internal reporting fields required (cost center mapping) so we can add them to the CSV if needed.

I’ve kicked off a DocuSign envelope for the pilot SOW (link below) — once signed we’ll prioritize activation.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/overview/ABC-123-PO-activation
Drive intake folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cVendorIntake

Thanks all — will follow up if any AP changes come in from Acme.

Best,

Soojin Lee
